title: Price Band Table for Settlement Restocking: Northgate Purchases & Returns Special Orders
content:
Price band table for the settlement restocking fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on a changed-mind return of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership.

## Piece value points

When the refunded sale line's unit price is below 500.00, 1 percentage point is added; when it is at least 500.00 but below 1000.00, 0.5 point is added; otherwise nothing is added.

The unit price is the one recorded on the sale line of the received return authorization; the points are added to the single percentage applied to the changed-mind refund.

| Unit price of the refunded sale line (USD) | Points added to the rate |
|---|---|
| below 500.00 | 1 |
| 500.00 to below 1000.00 | 0.5 |
| 1000.00 or more | none |

## Both sides of each band (hypothetical prices)

| Unit price | Points added |
|---|---|
| 499.99 | 1 |
| 500.00 | 0.5 |
| 999.99 | 0.5 |
| 1000.00 | none |
